findings.why: Familial-status steering under the Fair Housing Act — describes who the home is FOR, not what it IS.
findings.fix_hint: Describe the property fact instead: bedroom count, yard size, layout. Let the buyer self-select.

findings.why: Explicit protected-class buyer descriptor (race/religion/national origin/disability/familial status/age).
findings.fix_hint: Remove the buyer descriptor entirely. ('Adult community' is legal only with a verified HOPA exemption — flag to Farrice, never assume.)

findings.why: Religious landmark tied to buyer fit = religion-based steering. Bare distance facts are fine.
findings.fix_hint: State the distance fact alone, or cut the landmark; never attach it to who should buy.

findings.why: Schools belong in caption data, not spoken targeting (policy: _active/clients/jen-listings/CLAUDE.md — schools off camera).
findings.fix_hint: Move school names/ratings to the caption as a labeled data point; cut from the spoken script.

findings.why: Proximity to a place of worship as a selling point drifts toward religious steering.
findings.fix_hint: Prefer neutral anchors (park, main street, transit) unless the landmark is a pure location fact.

findings.why: Unverifiable environment absolute stated as fact ('quiet cul-de-sac' is a location fact — not flagged).
findings.fix_hint: Anchor to a verifiable feature (end of a cul-de-sac, double-pane windows) or soften to observation.
